title: Run-Length Encoding
statement: Read a string of uppercase letters (no spaces, length >= 1) from stdin. Print its run-length encoding: for each maximal run of consecutive identical characters, print the character followed by its run length, with no separators between groups (e.g. AAABCCDD -> A3B1C2D2). Even a run of length 1 must include its count.
starter_code:
s = input().strip()
# TODO: build and print the run-length encoding of s
hints: Walk through the string with two pointers: one marking the start of the current run, one scanning forward while the character stays the same
Append '<char><count>' to a list for each run, then join and print at the end
